input.quote: a. Grant. TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.
input.rationale: The grant in § 2(a) runs to Client only, with no coverage for our affiliates or for contractors acting on our behalf (§ 8(c) only permits access by our officers, employees and approved agents), so affiliate/contractor use is outside the licence. The licence is a term licence lasting until termination (§ 2(c)), and § 13(b) cuts off Sections 2 and 3 promptly for "any violations or breach" of §§ 8a–8c with no materiality threshold or cure period — effectively a near-discretionary revocation. § 15 permits assignment to an affiliate but not to a successor in an M&A transaction. Redline extends the grant to affiliates and contractors, limits the licence cut-off to uncured material breach, and adds successor transfer.

proposal.summary: Extend licence to Client affiliates and contractors, permit transfer to a successor, and limit licence cut-off to uncured material breach
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the licence to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, allowed transfer to a successor in a merger or acquisition, and limited the automatic cut-off of the licence to uncured material breaches, so operational use and transaction continuity are protected. If helpful, we can accept affiliate coverage on written notice as a fallback.

ops.oldText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business
ops.newText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client, its affiliates and its contractors acting on Client's behalf a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business

ops.oldText: except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate or to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of the assigning party's assets.

ops.oldText: (b) any violations or breach by Client of Sections 8a - 8c
ops.newText: (b) any material breach by Client of Sections 8a - 8c that remains uncured thirty (30) days after written notice thereof
